offers_products.reason: Revenue comes from construction and site development work; materials like concrete and aggregate are incidental to projects.

offers_services.reason: Site development, highway and bridge construction, concrete foundations, plumbing and surveying are contracted construction services.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Customers are government agencies, data center and e-commerce developers, and homebuilders, not households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells to state transportation agencies, blue-chip data center and warehouse customers, and national homebuilders.

recurring_revenue.reason: Revenue is project-based construction contracts for highways, sites and foundations, though homebuilders reorder repeatedly.

cyclical_demand.reason: Data center, commercial site and residential foundation work depends on new construction that can be delayed in downturns.

big_ticket.reason: Large site development, highway and bridge projects are big, infrequent contracts for each customer.

people_delivered.reason: Construction relies on heavy equipment, materials and fleets as well as labor; it is not primarily a labor-time service.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are state and federal transportation agencies, blue-chip e-commerce and data center firms, and national homebuilders.

asset_heavy.reason: Earthmoving and paving work needs large equipment fleets, plants and aggregate operations that need ongoing investment.
